capability_contract.server_authority: The server has its own TCB/CSpace/VSpace/fault endpoint plus the ROMFS endpoint; it receives no PCI, IRQ, DMA, device or raw VSpace capability.
capability_contract.probe_authority: The probe has its own TCB/CSpace/VSpace/fault endpoint plus the ROMFS endpoint only.
